overview_description.description:
Oscar is a health insurance company that offers individual and family plans, medicare advantages, and small group products.

It employs technology, design, and data to humanize health care. The company offers plans to individuals, couples, and families living in parts of New York, New Jersey, California, and Texas who don’t receive health insurance from an employer.

In 2012, Joshua Kushner, Kevin Nazemi, and Mario Schlosser headquartered Oscar Health in New York, New York.

about_short_description.short_description: Oscar is a health insurance company that offers individual and family plans, medicare advantages, and small group products.

product.name: Individual & Family Health Plans
product.description: Health insurance plans for individuals and families, including Bronze, Silver, and Gold tiers with different premiums and cost-sharing levels.

product.name: Small Group Health Plans
product.description: Employer-sponsored health insurance plans for small businesses, providing employees with medical coverage through Oscar’s group offerings.

product.name: Oscar for Employers (ICHRA)
product.description: An employer health-benefits offering based on Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements, allowing businesses to reimburse employees for eligible individual coverage costs.

product.name: Medicare Advantage Plans
product.description: Medicare Advantage health insurance plans for eligible Medicare beneficiaries, combining Medicare-covered benefits with plan-specific networks and cost sharing.

product.name: Oscar Care Virtual Urgent Care
product.description: A virtual urgent-care service that connects members with providers by video, phone, or messaging for non-emergency medical issues, prescriptions, and refills.

product.name: Oscar Primary Care
product.description: A virtual primary-care service for routine visits, preventive care, and ongoing condition management in select service areas.
